column1: # Live-state topics (scripts/live-collect.py). Columns, tab separated: topic, words of the `hs sys` read, interval in seconds,
# while the storage is locked: run|skip. The key is hs:v1:<topic>.
# The `live` topic reads `hs sys live status`; it sees its own previous document because the collector runs the command before it takes
# its own Redis lock or issues its own GET/SET. This means the `live` row is one collection behind, which is expected, not staleness.
